title_en: Technology and Engineering (16/20): A Technician Services an Elevator
note_en: In 他让电梯上下运行了几次 "he ran the elevator up and down a few times," 让 is a causative verb: "make/let someone or something do something." English often folds the causing into the verb itself ("run the elevator"), but Chinese spells it out as 让 + doer + action. Notice also that 几次 "a few times" comes after the verb, not before it as in many English adverbs of frequency.
